## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

gear_cols <- c(
  Pot  = "#d95f02",
  BRUV = "#1b9e77"
)
```

## Design

```{r}
#| label: make-design

design <- expand_grid(
  visit = c(
    "Visit 1",
    "Visit 2 (at least 24 h later)"
  ),
  site  = 1:6
) |>
  mutate(
    gear = case_when(
      visit == "Visit 1" & site %% 2 == 1 ~ "Pot",
      visit == "Visit 1"                  ~ "BRUV",
      site %% 2 == 1                      ~ "BRUV",
      TRUE                                ~ "Pot"
    ),
    gear = factor(
      gear,
      levels = c("Pot", "BRUV")
    ),
    x    = site * 400
  )

shore <- tibble(
  x = seq(0, 2800, by = 20)
) |>
  mutate(
    y = 0.55 + 0.06 * sin(x / 180)
  )
```

## Schematic

```{r}
#| label: fig-design-schematic
#| fig-width: 5.5
#| fig-height: 4.5

design |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data        = shore,
    mapping     = aes(
      x    = x,
      ymin = y,
      ymax = 1
    ),
    fill        = "grey60",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  aes(
    x      = x,
    y      = 0.35,
    colour = gear,
    shape  = gear
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = site),
    colour = "white",
    size   = 3.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x     = 400,
    xend  = 800,
    y     = 0.12,
    yend  = 0.12,
    arrow = arrow(
      ends   = "both",
      length = unit(2, "mm")
    )
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x     = 600,
    y     = 0.04,
    label = "≥ 400 m",
    size  = 3.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ visit,
    ncol = 1
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = gear_cols) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      Pot  = 15,
      BRUV = 16
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(150, 2650),
    ylim = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x       = NULL,
    y       = NULL,
    colour  = NULL,
    shape   = NULL,
    caption = "Soak time 65 min; all stations shallower than 40 m"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "top",
    strip.text       = element_text(
      face   = "bold",
      hjust  = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 4)
    ),
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill   = "#dbeafe",
      colour = NA
    ),
    panel.spacing    = unit(4, "mm")
  )
```
